purpose: test whether a mathematically lossless column reduction can reduce the frozen R1 SciPy assignment latency without changing R1 outputs, formal results, or permissions

S0.definition: copy the complete 32x8192 float32 logits to CPU float64, subtract float64 epsilon times the original candidate index, and call scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment(maximize=True)

S1.definition: after the unchanged complete CPU float64 transfer and unchanged epsilon adjustment, retain every original column at or above each row's 32nd-largest adjusted-score threshold, take the ascending original-index union, solve the reduced matrix with the same SciPy call, and map columns back to original indices

S2.definition: GPU float64 tie-safe union construction followed by reduced D2H and the same CPU SciPy solve
S2.authorization_condition: S1 passes every equivalence and engineering gate in a separately frozen result

mathematical_boundary.statement: with 32 assigned rows, a strictly lower-than-row-top32 selected edge cannot belong to an optimum because at most 31 other rows can occupy those 32 better columns
mathematical_boundary.tie_rule: all columns tied at the row top32 cutoff must be retained
mathematical_boundary.guarantee_scope: the reduced union contains at least one global optimum under the adjusted scores
mathematical_boundary.non_guarantee: the theorem alone does not guarantee the identical SciPy optimum when multiple global optima exist
mathematical_boundary.required_resolution: S1 must match S0 slot_to_candidate, sorted selected_indices, hard_assignment, and adjusted objective on every preregistered case; equal objective alone is insufficient

formal_gate_feasibility_check.formal_rerun_authorization_condition: a separately frozen optimized full-R1 artificial benchmark must first satisfy the unchanged 1.15 ratio and all equivalence gates
formal_gate_feasibility_check.note: S1 retains full D2H and the profiled R1 model-forward median already exceeds the implied limit; engineering improvement cannot be interpreted as formal-gate recovery

forbidden: read any D6 development, confirmation, holdout, official-test, checkpoint, STL, or NPZ payload
construct an optimizer or update model state
replace exact global assignment with greedy, auction, approximate, or nondeterministic selection under the R1 name
treat equal objective or equal sorted selected set as sufficient when slot mapping differs
drop columns tied at the row top32 cutoff
change the frozen epsilon adjustment, SciPy maximize call, formal thresholds, or R0 denominator
benchmark S1 or implement S2 as a side effect of protocol locking
use an engineering speedup to authorize formal rerun, training, seed1, confirmation, D6B, selection, or sealed access
